description_en: Queries the alert settings for assets. The default alert setting is balance mode. A detailed asset list is returned only in strict mode
description_zh: 查询资产的告警设置，资产告警设置默认为均衡模式，只有严格模式才会返回详细的资产列表
name: ListClientAlertMode

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the protection mode. Valid values:
strict: Strict mode. Defense mode has a certain risk of false positives and is recommended for use during critical event protection.
balance: Balance mode. Defense mode detects more suspicious risks while reducing false positives
parameters.help_zh:
指定防护模式。取值：
strict：严格模式，有一定的误报风险，建议在重保期间使用。
balance：均衡模式，在减少误报的情况下检出更多可疑风险
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member accounts in the resource folder (Alibaba Cloud account).
You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to retrieve this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

Data.description_en: The data returned in the response

Count.description_en: The total number of returned entries

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
